## Reproduce the controller count without the temporary generator

Run this Python3 snippet from repository root. It expands all literal controller HTTP attributes, including attributes grouped on one line, class Route prefixes, absolute overrides and aliases. It validates against the existing source map instead of assuming a fixed expected count. Production route source at this HEAD uses the supported literal patterns; for future dynamic/convention routing re-run MVC discovery rather than generalizing this scanner.

```python
from pathlib import Path
import json, re

rows = []
files = sorted(Path("RoadGuardSystem.API/Controllers").glob("*.cs"))
for file in files:
    text = file.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
    cls = re.search(r"public\s+(?:sealed\s+)?class\s+(\w+)", text)
    assert cls, file
    prefixes = re.findall(r'\bRoute\("([^"\n]+)"\)', text[:cls.start()]) or [""]
    for match in re.finditer(
        r'\bHttp(Get|Post|Put|Patch|Delete|Head|Options)(?:\("([^"\n]*)"\))?(?=\s*[,\]])', text
    ):
        verb, suffix = match.group(1).upper(), match.group(2) or ""
        for prefix in prefixes:
            if suffix.startswith("~/"):
                route = suffix[2:]
            elif suffix.startswith("/"):
                route = suffix.lstrip("/")
            else:
                route = prefix.rstrip("/") + ("/" + suffix if suffix else "")
            route = route.replace("{version:apiVersion}", "1")
            route = route.replace("[controller]", cls.group(1).removesuffix("Controller"))
            route = "/" + re.sub(r"\{([^}:]+):[^}]+\}", r"{\1}", route).strip("/")
            rows.append((verb, route))

index = json.loads(Path(
    "docs/RoadGuard-Backend-Official/10_Traceability/api-source-map.json"
).read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
assert set(rows) == {(row["method"], row["route"]) for row in index}
assert len(rows) == len(set(rows)), "Check method/path collisions"
print({"controllers": len(files), "operations": len(rows),
       "paths": len({path for _, path in rows})})
```

Observed result: controllers47, operations241, paths223. `GET /health` is separately identified at Program.cs:91; this snippet intentionally counts controllers only. All1314current C# production/test files outside build outputs were found in the hash-revalidated source index; no unindexed current C# file was observed.
